module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Isolated Margin Call Warning on Single Sub-Account
precondition: Sub-account #3 suffers adverse floating loss; margin level drops to 100%.
expected: Sub-account #3 flagged 'MARGIN_CALL'; email alert dispatched to investor and manager; remaining 9 accounts unaffected.
coverage_note: Requires configured stop-out/leverage/news/swap/notification fixtures beyond the verified account margin cases.
